info.name: Microsoft Azure Retrieves List Of Jobs Based On Filter Parameters

params.name: api-version
params.description: The API version to use for this operation.

params.name: maxpagesize
params.description: Number of objects to return per page.

params.name: status
params.description: If specified, filter jobs by status.

params.name: queueId
params.description: If specified, filter jobs by queue.

params.name: channelId
params.description: If specified, filter jobs by channel.

params.name: classificationPolicyId
params.description: If specified, filter jobs by classificationPolicy.

params.name: scheduledBefore
params.description: If specified, filter on jobs that was scheduled before or at given timestamp. Range: (-Inf, scheduledBefore].

params.name: scheduledAfter
params.description: If specified, filter on jobs that was scheduled at or after given value. Range: [scheduledAfter, +Inf).

items.docs: Retrieves list of jobs based on filter parameters.

params.description: If specified, select workers who have a channel configuration with this channel.

params.description: If specified, select workers who are assigned to this queue.

params.name: hasCapacity
params.description: If set to true, select only workers who have capacity for the channel specified by `channelId` or for any channel if `channelId` not specified. If set to false, then will return all workers including workers without any capacity for jobs. Defaults to false.
